## Which country has the most medals overall?
According to the Olympic Foundation for Culture and Heritage, the U.S. leds the [all-time medal count](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/2024-paris-games-most-olympic-medals-ever/) going into the Paris Games with a total of 2,975 Olympic medals, followed by the now-defunct Soviet Union, with 1,204 medals, and Germany, with 1,058 medals.
